story.body: You gave Nick the second of two words to come in on, and you would not let a rival memory carry the old cue off. You would not say the words into the room. Burbage tried the new cue and called it better. You sent the boy to the lute, and you left the three leaves in the chest.

story.body: You went on in a house that did not ask for a new sentence. Kemp took the laugh the book already had. You left the part unnamed, and you left the book as it stood.
